## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (e.g. `feat(events): ...`)
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed behavior
- [ ] Generated code is up to date (`make generate`), if SQL queries or the OpenAPI spec changed
- [ ] New database changes are in a new migration (released migrations are not edited)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `deploy/`), if behavior or configuration changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, logs or screenshots
